name: Cloud Cache Service
description: Windows MDM settings in the Cloud Cache Service category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Cache Directory
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the location of the local cache location.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\frxccd\Parameters\CacheDirectory
Type: REG_SZ

properties.name: Proxy Directory
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the location of the proxy disk location. This location must not be on a network path.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\frxccds\Parameters\ProxyDirectory
Type: REG_SZ

properties.name: Write Cache Directory
properties.description:
NOTE: Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the location of the write cache file location. This location must not be on a network path.

Registry Entry: HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\frxccds\Parameters\WriteCacheDirectory
Type: REG_SZ
